description: Return a Gimmeclip selection link for 0.5–60 seconds of a public YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Bluesky, VK, LinkedIn or Weibo video. Read llms_full_txt first to choose source-video timestamps. The user opens the link to preview, adjust and create the clip. Does not render, download, or verify that the video is available. For a finished watch link use share_video on https://gimmeclip.com/mcp.

end.description: End in source-video seconds; 0.5–60 seconds after start.

url.description: Any public http(s) link, e.g. "docs.stripe.com/payments", "github.com/honojs/hono", a PDF or a video URL. The scheme is optional.
